text:
dan_arch: follow-up to CP split RFC: proposing a 'locality boundary' per-region to own ephemeral egress leases and src-ip affinity. CP stays global metadata authority.

priya_r: can you sketch differences vs relay/peering?

dan_arch: ascii:
```
global-cp
  |
  +-- locality-us -> egress-pool-us (ENI/NAT or privatelink)
  +-- locality-eu -> egress-pool-eu
```
boundaries are thin: lease manager, short-lived certs, metrics; they do NOT host model runtime.

jamal_s: security: boundary keys increase blast radius. rotation?

dan_arch: short-lived KMS-wrapped keys and signed lease tokens with TTL (default 10m). renewal required; if CP unreachable, boundary serves active leases until expiry and marks degraded. include nonce to prevent replay.

sara_ops: private-only tenants?

dan_arch: same surface; egress-pool maps to private endpoint (peering/privatelink) instead of NAT.

infra-bot: checklist: [boundary image], [lease-proto v1], [metrics export], [private mapping], [cutover playbook].

priya_r: rollout: feature-flag per-tenant; start with dev tenants in one region for 2w, monitor p95, egress bill, NAT exhaustion.

jamal_s: tests: add route-flap integration to ensure no src-ip flip mid-connection during lease renewals.

dan_arch: I'll add RFC appendix with token format, TTLs, health signals, and rollout gates. Action items: dan update appendix EOD Fri; priya security checklist Mon; jamal tests Wed; sara rollout playbook Fri.
